Hint: Let $$k(x) = f(x) \slash g(x)$$ , and verify the following steps:

list.item: $$\frac{k(x + h) - k(x)}{h} = \frac{f(x + h)g(x) - f(x)g(x + h)}{hg(x + h)g(x)}$$

By adding $$\left\lbrack - f(x)g(x) + f(x)g(x) \right\rbrack$$ to the numerator and simplifying, show that $$\frac{k(x + h) - k(x)}{h} = \frac{1}{g(x + h)g(x)} \times \left\{ \left\lbrack \frac{f(x + h) - f(x)}{h} \right\rbrack \cdot g(x) - \left\lbrack \frac{g(x + h) - g(x)}{h} \right\rbrack \cdot f(x) \right\}$$

$$\begin{array}{l} {k^{\prime}(x) = \lim\limits_{h\rightarrow 0}\frac{k(x + h) - k(x)}{h}} \\ {\phantom{k^{\prime}(x)} = \frac{g(x)f^{\prime}(x) - f(x)g^{\prime}(x)}{\left\lbrack g(x) \right\rbrack^{2}}} \end{array}$$
